Reveal.js 5.1.0, vendored so the deck runs offline from file://.

Source:   npm pack reveal.js@5.1.0
Tarball:  sha256 524caf847e98033595943d994725dd357d20c7d07ad18afbaa932f1535e636e7
License:  MIT (LICENSE in this folder)

Copied:   dist/reveal.js, dist/reveal.esm.js, dist/reveal.css, dist/reset.css,
          plugin/notes/ (notes.js, notes.esm.js, plugin.js, speaker-view.html)
Left out: dist/*.map (source maps) and dist/theme/ (built-in themes and their
          fonts). The deck uses its own theme.css and the fonts in ../../fonts/.

One edit: in plugin/notes/notes.js and notes.esm.js the bundled Markdown
"smartypants" rule replaced "---" with a literal U+2014 character. It is
rewritten as the JavaScript escape "\u2014" (same string at run time), so the
repo copy lint, which bans that character in every tracked file, passes.

The deck loads the UMD builds (reveal.js, notes.js) with classic script tags:
ES module scripts do not load from file:// in Chrome.
